The ‘2026 iCatCare consensus guidelines on the diagnosis and management of chronic kidney disease in cats’ from International Cat Care (iCatCare) Veterinary Society seek both to supply updated information – with the addition of dedicated sections on comorbidities, anaesthesia and analgesia – and to discuss the importance of early diagnosis" (42693626 (PMC13554608) Introduction; ref [1]=26936494)
